criteria.text: Sharing is opt-in per transcript and presents a review/redaction step before publication; no automatic or implicit sharing path exists.
criteria.test_id: issue-1178-c1: requires caller-reviewed snapshot content and has no external auto-share path

criteria.text: The backend creates an immutable sanitized snapshot with owner, recipient scope, created/expiry/revoked timestamps, and source-session provenance.
criteria.test_id: issue-1178-c2: stored snapshots remain immutable after the source input changes

criteria.text: Recipient authorization is checked on every list/read/download operation. Guessed IDs, revoked links, expired links, cross-organization users, and deleted source sessions fail closed.
criteria.test_id: issue-1178-c3: enforces the complete read authorization matrix

criteria.text: A deterministic sanitizer removes credentials, authorization headers, secret-shaped values, host filesystem paths, hidden/system instructions, disallowed tool payloads, and excluded attachments before bytes are stored or transmitted.
criteria.test_id: issue-1178-c4: deterministically excludes every protected category and redacts secret patterns

criteria.text: Owners can revoke immediately; revocation invalidates cached/download access and is durably audited without logging transcript content.
criteria.test_id: issue-1178-c5: create, recipient read, revoke, and immediate denial are persisted and audited

criteria.text: The UI clearly distinguishes the private source session from its shared snapshot and displays recipients, expiration, exclusions, and revocation state.
criteria.reason: Desktop Flutter UI is explicitly deferred by the orchestrator for this backend-only slice.

criteria.text: `OPENCODE_AUTO_SHARE` and external OpenCode share endpoints remain disabled and are guarded by regression tests/config checks.
criteria.test_id: issue-1178-c7: share-related api_server source contains no external OpenCode sharing references
